hook: Atmospheric oxygen data show the ocean carbon sink grew since 1990 while the land sink did not.
hook_turn: while the land sink did not.

readout.label: Ocean carbon sink growth per decade

summary: Thirty years of atmospheric O2 and CO2 measurements were used to separate ocean and land uptake of fossil carbon. The ocean sink grew and took up 35% of emissions over 1990 to 2019, while the net land sink showed no robust trend. This conflicts with many process-based models, though the land estimate carries a large uncertainty of 0.5 Pg C per year.
title: Atmospheric O2 reveals a strengthening ocean carbon sink and a stagnant net land sink since 1990.
